defects: Section heading 'Six weeks at the wheel' introduces both the 6-week course and the monthly open-studio membership

defects: Hero vessel shelf illustration is bottom-aligned with the text column on desktop, leaving open space in the upper-right quadrant

defects: Large empty vertical gap between the bullet list and the bottom button inside the dark Open-studio membership card on desktop

defects: No imagery or illustrations anywhere on the page

defects: Two-column split offering card has uneven content height, leaving blank space and unaligned CTA buttons in the right column on desktop

defects: Desktop 'TWO WAYS IN' section heading is constrained to a narrow column that wraps onto four short lines with empty space beside it
